content: {"reasoning":"The denial was CO-197 (prior auth missing at time of service), and this payer offers no retroactive authorization and no peer-to-peer. An appeal was already tried. There is no valid path to collect from the payer, and patient billing doesn't count toward the objective since this isn't the patient's contractual share for a properly authorized service. The balance is uncollectible from the payer given the missing auth and no retro window.","action":"write_off"}
